what_it_does: This paper describes a low-noise amplifier for millimeter-wave frequencies (used in 5G, radar, and satellite communication) that can handle strong interfering signals without distorting. Traditional amplifiers optimize for weak signals but perform poorly when strong blockers are present. This design uses a Doherty active load modulation technique that dynamically redistributes current and voltage internally, adjusting the gain-versus-linearity trade-off based on the input signal strength. This allows the amplifier to maintain clean output whether receiving faint signals or accidentally picking up powerful nearby transmitters.
